title: Human-approved research-readiness, remaining-roadmap, and report wave
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's September 5, 2026 instruction to start priorities 1 through 8. Verify the production deployment of PR #48; assess the secure recurring Web-research boundary without self-attesting external controls; improve decision-ready evidence for all 27 registered HPCI systems, all 13 public procurement cases, and the six EEA1 applications; preserve unsupported values as Coverage Gaps; publish the four remaining roadmap families; and generate a bilingual, report-ready FS3.0 evidence package. All research outputs must use public information only and remain provisional, single-model, and Consensus-incomplete. The instruction authorizes publication through a Pull Request to main, but does not authorize merging that new Pull Request, unattended production research, procurement, or technology adoption.
